
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/23593015" title="发布于 2026-11-08 16:09">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">数学杂题（一）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一">一</h2>
<p>我们约定对于 01 串 <span class="math inline">\(s,t\)</span></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[s\subseteq t\Longleftrightarrow s\operatorname{and} t=s
\]</div><p></p><p>对于 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 阶排列 <span class="math inline">\(\sigma\)</span> 和长为 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 的 01 串 <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span></p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sigma(s)=s_{\sigma(1)}s_{\sigma(2)}\dots s_{\sigma(m)}
\]</div><p></p><p>设所有长 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的 01 串的集合为 <span class="math inline">\(S_{n}\)</span>。</p>
<p>给定正整数 <span class="math inline">\(n\ge 5\)</span>。设 <span class="math inline">\(A\subseteq S_n\)</span>。若 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 同时满足：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\forall a\in A,\operatorname{popcnt}(a)=4\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\forall b\in \{s\in S_n\mid\operatorname{popcnt}(s)=2\},\exists a\in A,b\subseteq a\)</span></li>
</ul>
<p>则称 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>。</p>
<p>（1）当 <span class="math inline">\(n=8\)</span> 时，若集合 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>，求 <span class="math inline">\(|A|\)</span> 的最小值。<br>
（2）若 <span class="math inline">\(A_1,A_2\)</span> 都有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(|A_1|,|A_2|\)</span> 均为最小值，定义等价关系 <span class="math inline">\(\cong\colon A_1\cong A_2\Longleftrightarrow \exists \sigma, \{\sigma(a)\mid a\in A_1\}=A_2\)</span>。找出所有等价类。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<h3 id="subtask-1">Subtask 1</h3>
<p>求最小值的常见方法是：证一个足够紧的下界并构造下界。</p>
<p>注意到 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 最多覆盖 <span class="math inline">\(C_4^2=6\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span>，共 <span class="math inline">\(C_8^2=28\)</span> 种 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span>。得到下界 <span class="math inline">\(\lceil28/6\rceil=5\)</span>，但这还不够紧。</p>
<p>考虑维护一个初始为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 的数组 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{cnt}\)</span>，每当一个 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 被一个 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 覆盖就令 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{cnt}\leftarrow \mathrm{cnt}+b\)</span>。</p>
<p>考虑 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span>：每个 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 至少被覆盖 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 次，最后 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{cnt}\)</span> 至少是 <span class="math inline">\((7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7)\)</span>。再考虑 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>：每个 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 会使 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{cnt}\leftarrow \mathrm{cnt}+3a\)</span>。最终 <span class="math inline">\(\mathrm{cnt}\)</span> 每一位都是 <span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 的倍数，至少是 <span class="math inline">\((9,9,9,9,9,9,9,9)\)</span>。</p>
<p>考虑总和得到下界 <span class="math inline">\(\lceil72/12\rceil=6\)</span>。</p>
<p>给出一组构造：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A_0=\left\{
\begin{aligned}
&amp;\texttt{11110000},\\
&amp;\texttt{00001111},\\
&amp;\texttt{11001100},\\
&amp;\texttt{11000011},\\
&amp;\texttt{00111100},\\
&amp;\texttt{00110011}
\end{aligned}
\right\}
\]</div><p></p><p>可以看成用 <span class="math inline">\(6\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(4\)</span> 阶完全图覆盖 <span class="math inline">\(8\)</span> 阶完全图。</p>
<p><img src="https://cdn.luogu.com.cn/upload/image_hosting/qtpf7ihk.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>或是 <span class="math inline">\(8\)</span> 个维度两两分组，然后 <span class="math inline">\(4\)</span> 个组两两连边。</p>
<p><img src="https://cdn.luogu.com.cn/upload/image_hosting/pyuvhgrm.webp" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="subtask-2">Subtask 2</h3>
<p>程序暴力枚举得到共 <span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 个等价类，代表元素：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[A_0=\left\{
\begin{aligned}
&amp;\texttt{11110000},\\
&amp;\texttt{00001111},\\
&amp;\texttt{11001100},\\
&amp;\texttt{11000011},\\
&amp;\texttt{00111100},\\
&amp;\texttt{00110011}
\end{aligned}
\right\}\qquad
A_1=\left\{
\begin{aligned}
&amp;\texttt{11110000},\\
&amp;\texttt{00001111},\\
&amp;\texttt{11001100},\\
&amp;\texttt{10100011},\\
&amp;\texttt{00111100},\\
&amp;\texttt{01010011}
\end{aligned}
\right\}\qquad
A_2=\left\{
\begin{aligned}
&amp;\texttt{11110000},\\
&amp;\texttt{11001100},\\
&amp;\texttt{11000011},\\
&amp;\texttt{00101011},\\
&amp;\texttt{00011110},\\
&amp;\texttt{00110101}
\end{aligned}
\right\}
\]</div><p></p><p>此外，对于任意最优解 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span>（即 <span class="math inline">\(|A|=6\)</span>），不难证明如下两条性质：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 中每个维度恰好被覆盖 <span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 次</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\{\operatorname{not} a\mid a\in A\}\)</span> 满足性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>，同样是最优解</li>
</ul>
</details>
<h2 id="二">二</h2>
<p>已知 <span class="math inline">\(n,m\in \R^+\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{cases}
n+\ln n=3 \\
1+\ln m=e^2/m
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>求 <span class="math inline">\(nm\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>考虑对应函数单调性，<span class="math inline">\(n,m\)</span> 均唯一。</p>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(x=\ln n,y=\ln m\)</span>。我们考虑转而求 <span class="math inline">\(x+y\)</span>。尽量把两个方程化成相同的形式：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{cases}
e^x+x=3 \\
e^{2-y}+(2-y)=3
\end{cases}
\]</div><p></p><p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(x=2-y\)</span>。从而 <span class="math inline">\(nm=e^2\)</span>。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="三">三</h2>
<p>解方程：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{2y^2-1}+\sqrt{y^2-3y-2}=\sqrt{2y^2+2y+3}+\sqrt{y^2-y+2}
\]</div><p></p><details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>诈骗题。</p>
<p>设：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
a&amp;=2y^2-1  \\
b&amp;=y^2-3y-2  \\
c&amp;=2y^2+2y+3  \\
d&amp;=y^2-y+2
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>显然 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,c,d\ge 0\)</span>。</p>
<p>发现 <span class="math inline">\(a,c\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(b,d\)</span> 二次项系数相同，这启发我们随机手玩一下发现 <span class="math inline">\(c-a=d-b=2y+4\)</span>。</p>
<p>因此原方程化为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}=\sqrt{a+2y+4}+\sqrt{b+2y+4}
\]</div><p></p><p>考虑从左边到右边是怎么变的，由于平方根函数单调增，两项同时变大或同时变小。由于等号成立，只能是 <span class="math inline">\(2y+4=0\)</span> 即 <span class="math inline">\(y=-2\)</span>，检验合法。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="四">四</h2>
<p>已知 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,c\in \R,a+b+c=0\)</span>。求证 <span class="math inline">\(2(a^4+b^4+c^4)=(a^2+b^2+c^2)^2\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>暴力题。代入 <span class="math inline">\(c=-a-b\)</span> 暴力展开就做完了。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="五">五</h2>
<p>集合 <span class="math inline">\(S=\{1,2,3,\dots,n\}\)</span>。正整数列 <span class="math inline">\(\{c_i\}_{i=1}^m\)</span> 满足 <span class="math inline">\(\sum_{i=1}^m c_i=n\)</span>。集合 <span class="math inline">\(\{A_i\}_{i=1}^m\)</span> 是对 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span> 的一个划分，满足 <span class="math inline">\(|A_i|=c_i\)</span>。设 <span class="math inline">\(k=\sum_{i=1}^m \left(\min(A_i)+\max(A_i)\right)\)</span>。设 <span class="math inline">\(K\)</span> 为所有可能的 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 取值组成的集合。求 <span class="math inline">\(\min(K)+\max(K)\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>我们考虑某种“反转”大小关系的对称性。</p>
<p>对于一个合法划分 <span class="math inline">\(A_1\sim A_m\)</span>，构造 <span class="math inline">\(B_i=\{n+1-x\mid x\in A_i\}\)</span>。显然 <span class="math inline">\(B_1\sim B_m\)</span> 也是合法划分。</p>
<p>不难证明</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{i=1}^m \left(\min(B_i)+\max(B_i)\right)=2m(n+1)-\sum_{i=1}^m \left(\min(A_i)+\max(A_i)\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>设 <span class="math inline">\(K\)</span> 为所有可能的 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 取值组成的集合。则</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\forall k\in K,2m(n+1)-k\in K
\]</div><p></p><p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(\min(K)+\max(K)=2m(n+1)\)</span>。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="六">六</h2>
<p>已知实数 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,c,x,y\)</span> 满足：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{align}
&amp; a+b+c        = 1  \tag{1}\\
&amp; a^2+b^2+c^2  = 3  \tag{2}\\
&amp; bc-x-2ya     = 0  \tag{3}\\
&amp; ca-x-2yb     = 0  \tag{4}\\
&amp; ab-x-2yc     = 0  \tag{5}
\end{align}
\]</div><p></p><p>证明 <span class="math inline">\(abc=-1\)</span> 或 <span class="math inline">\(abc=5/27\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>注意到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[(a+b+c)^2=(a^2+b^2+c^2)+2(ab+bc+ca)
\]</div><p></p><p>代入 <span class="math inline">\((1)(2)\)</span> 得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[ab+bc+ca=-1
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\((3)(4)(5)\)</span> 三式相加，得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
(bc+ca+ab)-3x-2y(a+b+c)&amp;=0\\
-1-3x-2y&amp;=0\\
y&amp;=-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{3}{2}x
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>代入 <span class="math inline">\((3)\)</span> 得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
bc-x-2\left(-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{3}{2}x\right)a&amp;=0  \\
bc-x+a+3ax&amp;=0  \\
(-1-ab-ca)-x+a+3ax&amp;=0  \\
a(-b-c+1+3x)-x-1&amp;=0  \\
a\left((a-1)+1+3x\right)-x-1&amp;=0  \\
a(a+3x)-x-1&amp;=0  \\
a^2+3ax-x-1&amp;=0  \\
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>解得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a=\frac{-3x\pm \sqrt{9x^2+4x+4}}{2}
\]</div><p></p><p><span class="math inline">\(b,c\)</span> 同理。</p>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a,b,c,y\)</span> 都可以用 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 表示。</p>
<p>设</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
f(x)&amp;=\frac{-3x+\sqrt{9x^2+4x+4}}{2}\\
g(x)&amp;=\frac{-3x-\sqrt{9x^2+4x+4}}{2}
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>那么 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,c\)</span> 每个都会从 <span class="math inline">\(\{f(x),g(x)\}\)</span> 中二选一。我们分类讨论 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span> 的个数，根据式 <span class="math inline">\((1)\)</span> 求 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>。</p>
<ol>
<li><span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(3f(x)=1\)</span>，无实数解。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(2\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(2f(x)+g(x)=1\)</span>，解得 <span class="math inline">\(x=0\)</span>，回代得 <span class="math inline">\(abc=-1\)</span>。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(f(x)+2g(x)=1\)</span>，解得 <span class="math inline">\(x=-4/9\)</span>，回代得 <span class="math inline">\(abc=5/27\)</span>。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(0\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(f(x)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(3g(x)=1\)</span>，无实数解。</li>
</ol>
<p>综上，<span class="math inline">\(abc=-1\)</span> 或 <span class="math inline">\(abc=5/27\)</span>。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="七">七</h2>
<p>求证：<span class="math inline">\(\forall a,b,c\in (0,+\infty)\)</span>，有</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{\frac{a}{a+2b+c}}+\sqrt{\frac{b}{a+b+2c}}+\sqrt{\frac{c}{2a+b+c}}\le \frac{3}{2}
\]</div><p></p><details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>柿子看上去很繁琐，设</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\begin{aligned}
s&amp;=a+b+c  \\
x&amp;=s+a  \\
y&amp;=s+b  \\
z&amp;=s+c 
\end{aligned}
\]</div><p></p><p>则上式简化为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{\frac{a}{y}}+\sqrt{\frac{b}{z}}+\sqrt{\frac{c}{x}}\le \frac{3}{2}
\]</div><p></p><p>先看何时取等，显然 <span class="math inline">\(a=b=c\)</span> 是取等的充分条件。</p>
<p>我们的目标是找到一些 <span class="math inline">\(\textcolor{#E74C3C}{T}\)</span> 满足</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{\frac{a}{y}}+\sqrt{\frac{b}{z}}+\sqrt{\frac{c}{x}}\le \textcolor{#E74C3C}{T}\le \frac{3}{2}
\]</div><p></p><p>由于左右两侧在 <span class="math inline">\(a=b=c\)</span> 时取等，这里两个 <span class="math inline">\(\le\)</span> 都必须在 <span class="math inline">\(a=b=c\)</span> 时取等。</p>
<p>根号很难处理，标准的技巧是 AM-GM <span class="math inline">\(\sqrt{uv}\le (u+v)/2\)</span>。<br>
对于第一项 <span class="math inline">\(\sqrt{a/y}\)</span>，我们需要找到 <span class="math inline">\(u,v\)</span> 使得 <span class="math inline">\(uv=a/y\)</span> 且当 <span class="math inline">\(a=b=c\)</span> 时有 <span class="math inline">\(u=v=1/2\)</span>。</p>
<p>经过一些尝试发现</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[u=\frac{2a}{x},v=\frac{x}{2y}
\]</div><p></p><p>恰好满足要求。</p>
<p>得到</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sqrt{\frac{a}{y}}+\sqrt{\frac{b}{z}}+\sqrt{\frac{c}{x}}\le\frac{1}{2}\left( \frac{2a}{x}+\frac{2b}{y}+ \frac{2c}{z}+\frac{x}{2y}+\frac{y}{2z}+\frac{z}{2x}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>只需要证右边 <span class="math inline">\(\le 3/2\)</span>。</p>
<p>对右边恒等变形，只保留 <span class="math inline">\(x,y,z\)</span>，分别用 <span class="math inline">\(x,y,z\)</span> 表示 <span class="math inline">\(a,b,c\)</span>，代入并整理，得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[右边=\frac{9}{4}-\frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{y}{x}+\frac{z}{y}+\frac{x}{z}\right)
\]</div><p></p><p>由 AM-GM 得</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\frac{y}{x}+\frac{z}{y}+\frac{x}{z}\ge 3
\]</div><p></p><p>因此</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\text{右边}\le \frac{3}{2}
\]</div><p></p><p>证毕。</p>
</details>
<h2 id="八">八</h2>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(A\subseteq \R\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(A\ne \varnothing\)</span>。若 <span class="math inline">\(\forall x,y\in A\)</span>，都有 <span class="math inline">\(x+y\in A,xy\in A\)</span> 那么称 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>。证明：若 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(a\neq \R\)</span>，则 <span class="math inline">\(\complement_\R A\)</span> 不具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>。</p>
<details>
<summary>题解</summary>
<p>显然 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(\complement_\R A\)</span> 均非空。</p>
<p>考虑反证，设 <span class="math inline">\(\complement_\R A\)</span> 也具有性质 <span class="math inline">\(P\)</span>。</p>
<p>我们尝试考虑 <span class="math inline">\(+,\times\)</span> 的单位元也就是 <span class="math inline">\(0,1\)</span> 这两个特殊数。不妨设 <span class="math inline">\(0\in A\)</span>。因此 <span class="math inline">\(\complement_\R A\)</span> 中就不能出现相反数对。</p>
<p>若 <span class="math inline">\(x\in \complement_\R A\)</span>，那么显然 <span class="math inline">\(-x\notin \complement_\R A\)</span> 即 <span class="math inline">\(-x\in A\)</span>。</p>
<p>可以平方消去负号，得到 <span class="math inline">\(x^2\in A\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(x^2\in \complement_\R A\)</span>，矛盾。</p>
</details>

</div>
